scope: Stable legible lighting as the camera moves, clear high-density phone rendering with usable quality choices, recovery after mobile backgrounding or graphics loss that preserves the world and authoring session, and intuitive house interior entry and exterior return with playable desktop/phone controls.

intuitiveness.evidence: Nearby Enter cabin/Enter house and Return outside now cover the cabin and both admitted imported house assets, including a rotated supported instance. Actual touch journeys enter from Explore/Fly, walk inside and return to the exact exterior camera. The inspected phone layouts retain reachable movement, authoring, quality and drawer controls at 360/390-pixel portrait and 640x360 landscape. Recovery offers clear retry/export choices; the storage warning is now readable above controls, and real touch Export downloads the newer live world after a failed save. These improvements close the earlier cabin-only and normal-mobile-export friction. This category assesses the demonstrated interaction design; physical-device graphics/lifecycle acceptance remains explicitly unproven and keeps the feature held.

accuracy.evidence: The critic independently exercised real IndexedDB synchronous put failure and post-request transaction abort, confirmed exact prior-record and live-world/history preservation, downloaded and validated the current world, and confirmed successful retry. Separate timeout/late-error and timeout/late-success probes exercise the captured-worker-identity guards without publication or uncaught callbacks. Source and browser evidence now separate whole-world admission from saved selection masks; both populated history stacks and a selected shelf survive actual WebGL loss. Measured source geometry supports explicit authored portal interiors rather than false shell-fitting claims. Native tests cover both houses on all four support rotations and exact ownership/lock isolation. The highp bounded bump correction removes a real numerical risk, but the affected Android/Brave phone has not verified the reported black surfaces, fuzziness and minimize/resume failures. Additional targeted recovery paths remain untested, listed separately; passing emulation is not physical-device acceptance.

wowFactor.evidence: Actual house and supported-recovery captures show furnished, lit, enclosed walkable rooms, visible nested selection and consistent ivory/dark-green controls. Reaching both imported houses and preserving their contents and exterior return pose makes a substantially more complete demonstration. The first-person captures still devote much of the view to the ceiling and show strong repetitive floor/table grain, with a plain, soft material treatment; the prior Toon capture amplifies streaking. There is no current proof that the reported camera-dependent black surfaces and fuzzy image are gone on the affected phone. Broader same-surface camera sweeps and device captures are needed before this full visual scope merits B+.

thinkingOutOfTheBox.evidence: A clean engine reload combined with whole-session worker admission, exact return-camera/controller restoration and export of retained recovery data provides a practical response to the pinned web backend's unsafe in-place graphics restart. Explicit portal rooms reuse the WFC furniture/contents graph for imported exterior shells without distorting furniture or claiming nonexistent architectural reconstruction. Distinct regional/support ownership, preserved masks and a consistent portable-save action make these combinations useful to authoring. This is demonstrated practical integration, not a claim of arbitrary catalog interiors, global illumination or universal mobile recovery.

blockingFindings: MRR-01 remains open: retest the affected physical Android/Brave phone on the final served build. Revisit the reported camera-dependent black surfaces and fuzzy rendering in None and available quality modes; background/minimize, resume, enter/return, and continue authoring. Record device/browser, actual completed-frame timing and drawing-buffer/CSS dimensions. The earlier user statement 'Yes loads now' confirmed startup transport only. Desktop GPU touch emulation does not close these newer device failures.

MRR-03 is narrowed to the genuinely remaining verification work: exercise an in-flight save followed by another requested save, delayed first-entry cancellation with a nontrivial authoring mask during background/loss, and saved-data read/blocked/quota or size-preflight failure after an existing good checkpoint. Check retained data, useful failure/retry, no late publication and exact live/session state. A named-room-plan loss case with a selected nested object and fresh rendered picking is also still absent from this recovery suite. These are residual coverage gaps, not assertions that the completed put/abort/late-worker/house-history cases fail.

MRR-04 remains open: provide same-surface top/orbit/fly/walk and grazing-angle comparisons, including restored styles, with legible phone density. Reduce or justify the visually dominant repetitive wood treatment and ceiling-heavy first-person framing in representative views. The shader's numerical correction supports a hypothesis, not proof of the original phone symptom's cause or cure. Keep broader FPS, audio and optional-catalog acceptance separate.

Imported houses use the distinct 8800x7800x2700 mm portal-room profile at a 120 mm floor datum; cabin remains 9400x9400x2700 at 80 mm and retains its room-plan capability. The portal rooms are not inferred layouts or physical fits inside the raw shells.

Native house ownership tests reject a forged same-category source-asset substitution, remove the replaced regional house's owned room tree, preserve distant content, enforce locked-descendant protection, and retain exact foundation nodes across supported interior creation/removal at all four turns.

House run 01 exposed a legitimate saved-mask/restore incompatibility. The worker now admits the complete world independently, then validates ordered, unique, bounded regional/fine selection cells and matching bounds, including a cleared 1x1 anchor. Fifteen session fixtures comprise four valid and eleven malformed cases; they are not fifteen negative tests.

Both populated history stacks, the selected nested shelf tier and supported deck/rotation context now have actual context-loss recovery evidence. Existing cabin freeze/active, style, modal-keyboard retry, Undo/Redo and exterior-return evidence is retained.

The critic's four deterministic desktop cases close synchronous put failure, abort after a successful put request, timeout followed by stale worker error, and timeout followed by stale valid success. Actual database and native downloaded files are inspected; successful retry is verified. No passing result is inferred merely from a visible Export button.

Normal phone Export is a real touch target and downloads the current live world after failed saving. The warning was previously obscured; the final centered, raised pointer-transparent toast is readable. The common top Export is made consistent across ordinary, interior and groundwork tools; the older interior footer export already existed, so the critic's initial claim of no in-room route was too strong.

Earlier null-key, malformed controller/selection, save-revision, transaction-abort, size-preflight, reload-budget and modal focus corrections remain. The critic's earlier sign-only lighting diagnosis stays explicitly retracted: CGE model Direction and local light emission have opposite defaults; explicit MinusZ orientation clarifies the corrected setup.

The critic's active-house save/export fixture exposed an indoor camera relocation during ordinary content publication. ApplyWorld was applying exterior FindStanding to indoor coordinates; the repaired path limits that reconciliation to the exterior. House run 01 failed, run 02 passed 24 checks after that correction, and run 03 retained strict before-edit/after-edit/before-export/after-export equality. The oracle was not weakened.

The source audit found that Fly-to-Walk used cabin fallback z=3.8 even though the smaller house requires |z|<3.52. The new room-profile FindStanding validates its entry candidate and any bounded scan candidates through CanStand. Actual touch flight in house run 03 reaches z=-17.498, returns to valid z approximately 3.0 and then walks forward; it passes all 27 checks. The no-standing-space failure branch is source-reviewed, not claimed runtime-tested.
limitations: The four main fault cases were executed by the critic; subsequent phone and active-house runs use critic-owned fixtures executed by the builder. All use desktop Chromium and desktop graphics. They do not measure affected-phone GPU precision, thermal behavior, OS process discard or phone FPS.

Late-event probes deliberately dispatch an event to an already terminated real Worker EventTarget after advancing a probe-owned clock through the actual timeout branch. They verify application ownership guards; they do not claim a browser spontaneously delivers that event after termination.

World export is the existing portable world envelope, not a full authoring-session export. Raw recovery export retains a full checkpoint. Storage remains best effort if the process dies before commit.

The raw house A main-body depth is about 7.385 m after existing normalization, while house F has an L-shaped recess. Whole bounding boxes do not justify fitting the old studio into either shell. The new portal profile honestly avoids that claim; imported-house multiroom plans and unrelated catalog buildings are not implicitly admitted.

Temporal full-plan recovery, blocked/read/quota distinctions, save-limit boundaries, a save queued behind an active transaction, late first-entry replies and nearby-target freshness are not covered by the completed cases. Ordinary page reload/context recreation on a desktop does not establish mobile OS discard survival.

Mixed instrumentation intervals include screenshots, transitions and recovery. Short audio protocol observations in the mobile suite do not pass sound quality or the broader performance/audio features.
